summary: Reviewed extraction moves deterministic study, summary, wrong-word, and report rules behind word-domain-core while native adapters retain JSON, clock, snapshot, and persistence ownership. NewWord remains four type-major questions per word, Review remains one selected question per entry, translations remain hidden before submit, and accepted native fixture outputs are unchanged.
provenanceLimit: The pre-extraction worktree contents of question_builder.rs and wrong_words_service.rs were frozen authoritative input. This review establishes parity for the extraction diff, not authorship, exact timing, intent, or verification of those earlier dirty changes.
